title: Jobs
description: Your open roles. Open a job to partners and recruiters with matching candidates can refer them to you. You won't see anyone's identity until they submit.

empty.filteredDescription: Try a different search or clear the filters.
empty.firstDescription: Add a role you're hiring for. Open it to partners and we'll tell you how many of their candidates fit, without revealing who they are.

new.title: New job
new.description: Start from an existing posting to fill the form automatically, then review every field before publishing.

edit.title: Edit {title}
edit.description: Requirement changes re-run matching in the background.

detail.flashPublished: Job published. Match counts will appear in a minute.
detail.flashDraft: Draft saved. Partners can't see it until you publish.
detail.privacyNotPublished: This job isn't published, so it isn't being matched. Publish it to see how many partner candidates fit.
detail.privacyNotOpen: This job isn't open to partners. Edit it and turn on partner referrals to be matched with their candidates.
detail.privacyShort: Partner candidates stay anonymous until they're submitted.
detail.privacyShortRefreshed: Partner candidates stay anonymous until they're submitted · updated {when}
detail.submittedEmptyShort: No one yet. You'll be notified when a partner submits someone.

submittedEmptyMatches.one: {count} partner candidate already fits this role.
submittedEmptyMatches.other: {count} partner candidates already fit this role.

detail.submittedEmptyBody: You'll be notified as soon as a partner submits someone.
detail.termsEmpty: No terms yet. Partners can't see this job until you add them.

form.title: Job title
form.hideClient: Hide the client's name from partner recruiters
form.descriptionHint: Paste the full job post. We can suggest skills and seniority from it. Suggestions only use words in your text, and you review them before saving.
form.suggestTooShort: Paste a fuller job description first.

suggested.one: Suggested {count} skill from the text. Review before saving.
suggested.other: Suggested {count} skills from the text. Review before saving.

form.languagesHint: Only list languages the role genuinely requires
form.openToPartners: Open this job to partner recruiters
form.openToPartnersHint: Recruiters with candidates who fit will see this job and can submit them. You'll see how many fit, but not who, until someone is submitted.
form.visibleTitle: What partners can see before submitting
form.visibleHint: Title, seniority, work arrangement and skills are always shown. The client's name follows the setting above.
form.clientInternalHint: Optional. Partners never see this name. Platform admins see it only to resolve a dispute. If you add it, Workatent catches duplicate referrals across all your jobs for this client. If you leave it blank, protection covers this job only, and you can't cite an earlier referral from another job in an objection.
form.clientDuplicateHint: Workatent also uses the client name to catch duplicate referrals across all your jobs for this client.

terms.title: Terms for partners
terms.description: Partners see these terms before they submit a candidate. Each referral keeps the terms in force when it was submitted.

basisHint.pct_base: Computed at hire from the first-year base salary.
basisHint.pct_total_cash: Computed at hire from base salary plus target bonus. Equity, signing bonus, benefits and relocation aren't included.
basisHint.pct_total_cash_br: Check whether your client contract counts the 13th salary and the 1/3 vacation bonus in total cash.
basisHint.flat: A fixed amount, whatever the salary.

terms.minimumHint: Applies when the computed fee is lower.
terms.currencyFollowsSalary: Fee currency: {currency}, the same as the salary.
terms.previewHint: From the salary band midpoint. The fee is computed at hire from the actual salary.
terms.previewNoBand: Add a salary band to see an estimate.
terms.remedy: If the hire leaves during the guarantee
terms.noGuaranteeNote: Partners will see that there's no guarantee.
terms.paymentHint: Days the client has to pay after the invoice. The invoice is issued at the start date.
terms.windowHint: How long a delivered referral keeps first position with this client. It can't be shorter than the introduction period in your client contract.
terms.shareSalary: Show partners the salary band and fee estimate
terms.shareSalaryHint: With a % fee, the estimate reveals the salary, so the band and the estimate are shown or hidden together. Partners always see the rate.
terms.splitNote: Set by Workatent. Each referral keeps the split in force when it's submitted.
terms.attestation: We hold the fee agreement directly with the end client.
terms.attestationHint: Jobs you hold for another agency can't be open to partner referrals.

existingReferrals.one: {count} referral was sent under earlier terms and keeps them. Partners with referrals in progress are told the terms changed.
existingReferrals.other: {count} referrals were sent under earlier terms and keep them. Partners with referrals in progress are told the terms changed.

terms.permanentOnly: Only permanent jobs can be open to partner referrals. Change the contract type or turn off partner referrals.

form.clientRequiredForPartners: Required to open this job to partners. If you hide the client's name, partners never see it.
form.restrictedHold: Saved, but hidden from partners while your organization is on a network hold.
form.restrictedRules: Saved, but hidden from partners until an organization admin accepts the current Network Rules.
form.userMustAccept: Accept Network Rules {label} to open jobs to partners.

errors.userMustAccept: Accept Network Rules {label} before you open a job to partners. Then save again.

messages.activated: Job published. Match counts appear within a minute.
messages.statusUpdated: Status updated. Matches for inactive jobs expire immediately.

statusUpdatedReleased.one: Status updated. {count} pending referral was declined as "Job filled".
statusUpdatedReleased.other: Status updated. {count} pending referrals were declined as "Job filled".

errors.termsIncomplete: Complete the terms for partners to open this job to partner referrals.

validation.salaryRange: Maximum must be at least the minimum
validation.clientRequired: Enter the client name or keep it confidential
validation.feeRateRange: Enter a rate from 1 to 50, with up to 2 decimals
validation.minimumPositive: Enter a minimum fee above 0, or leave it empty
validation.remedyRequired: Choose what happens if the hire leaves
validation.attestationRequired: Confirm you hold the fee agreement with the end client
validation.permanentForReferrals: Choose Permanent, or turn off partner referrals
validation.clientRequiredForPartners: Enter the client's real name to open this job to partners

import.title: Fill this job in seconds
import.subtitle: Paste the posting, drop a link or upload a file. We'll fill in what it says — you review everything before saving.
import.textPlaceholder: Paste the full job description here: title, requirements, location, salary…
import.urlHint: Works best with company career pages and Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, Gupy and similar. LinkedIn and Indeed block automatic reading — paste the text instead.
import.fileDrop: Drop a PDF, DOCX or TXT here, or click to choose
import.fileHint: Up to 5 MB. Scanned PDFs (images) can't be read.
import.skip: or fill it in manually below

done.one: {count} field filled. Check it below before saving.
done.other: {count} fields filled. Check them below before saving.

import.doneStructured: Read from the page's structured job data.

errors.invalidUrl: Enter a valid public https:// link.
errors.blockedSite: This site blocks automatic reading. Copy the posting text and use "Paste text" instead.
errors.fetchFailed: We couldn't open that link. Check it, or paste the text instead.
errors.notHtml: That link isn't a web page. Download the file and use "File" instead.
errors.fileType: Use a PDF, DOCX or TXT file.
errors.fileSize: The file is larger than 5 MB.
errors.noText: We couldn't find readable text. If it's a scanned PDF, paste the text instead.
errors.tooShort: Paste the full posting — at least a few sentences.

import.subtitleAi: Paste the posting, drop a link or upload a file (scanned PDFs too). AI reads it and fills in what it says — you review everything before saving.
import.doneAi: Read by AI. Nothing was invented: empty fields weren't stated in the posting.
import.fileHintAi: Up to 5 MB. Scanned PDFs are read by AI.

terms.amendedLine: Amended on {date} at both organizations' request

fee.pctTotalCash: {rate} of first-year total cash (base + target bonus)

searchTypeHint.contingent_exclusive: The client gives this job only to the hiring recruiter. The fee is due only on a hire.
searchTypeHint.contingent_shared: The client may also use other agencies or its own team. The fee is due only on a hire.
searchTypeHint.retained: Part of the fee is paid upfront (retainer). The split applies to the total fee, retainer included.

terms.noGuaranteeHint: The client gets no replacement or refund if the hire leaves early.

paymentTerms.one: Net {count} day from the invoice (issued at the start date)
paymentTerms.other: Net {count} days from the invoice (issued at the start date)

terms.paymentTermsZero: Due on the invoice date (issued at the start date)
terms.directClient: The hiring recruiter states it holds the fee agreement directly with the end client.
terms.estimateHint: From the salary band midpoint. At hire, the fee is computed from the actual salary. Shares are before sales tax.
terms.estimateHidden: {partner} keeps the salary band private, so no estimate is shown.
terms.flatShareHint: Before sales tax. Payable once the client's payment is verified.

shareAtHire.pctBase: {percent} of the fee (fee: {rate} of the base salary at hire)
shareAtHire.pctTotalCash: {percent} of the fee (fee: {rate} of total cash at hire)

terms.notRecorded: Terms not recorded (sent before the terms card)

network.title: Network rules for every job
network.ownership: Ownership: a delivered referral keeps first position with this client and its affiliates, for any role, for the job's ownership window from delivery.
network.priorPresentation: Prior presentation: the hiring recruiter has 5 business days after delivery to file an objection, with evidence.
network.response: Response: the hiring recruiter acts on a delivered referral within 5 business days. If there's no action after 10 business days, the sourcing recruiter may submit the candidate to other jobs, and the referral keeps its first position with this client.
network.payout: Payout: the hiring recruiter pays the sourcing recruiter's share directly, within 5 business days of receiving the client's payment. The share isn't held back for the guarantee.
network.tax: Sales tax: shares are before sales tax. Each organization adds the tax that applies when it invoices.
network.draftMarker: Draft network rules, pending legal review.

nudge.chipCurrency: Hidden from partners: check fee currency

listBanner.one: {count} active job is hidden from partners. Open it to see what's missing.
listBanner.other: {count} active jobs are hidden from partners. Open each one to see what's missing.

nudge.title: Hidden from partners
nudge.bodyTerms: Partners can't see this job or submit to it until you add its terms for partners. Referrals you already received aren't affected.
nudge.bodyPermanent: Only permanent jobs can be open to partner referrals. Change the contract type, or turn off partner referrals. Referrals you already received aren't affected.
nudge.bodyCurrency: The fee currency in this job's terms ({termsCurrency}) no longer matches its salary currency ({salaryCurrency}). Partners can't see this job until you review and save its terms, which publishes new terms in {salaryCurrency}. Referrals you already received keep their terms.
nudge.chipClientName: Hidden from partners: add the client's name
nudge.bodyClientName: Partners can't see this job until it has the client's real name. If you hide the client's name, it stays internal. Referrals already received aren't affected.
nudge.bodyHold: Your organization is on a network hold, so partners can't see this job. Its settings are saved, and it's visible again when the hold ends. Referrals you already received aren't affected.
nudge.bodyRules: Your organization hasn't accepted the current Network Rules, so partners can't see this job. It's visible again as soon as an organization admin accepts them. Referrals you already received aren't affected.
nudge.chipRules: Hidden from partners: rules not accepted
